scenes.caption: Have a burp cloth ready
scenes.narration_line: Keep a burp cloth or muslin square ready.
scenes.evidence: have a burp cloth or muslin square ready

scenes.caption: Support their head and neck
scenes.narration_line: Support your baby's head and neck; keep their back straight.
scenes.evidence: Support your baby's head and neck
safety_points: Keep their tummy and back straight, not curled up.

scenes.caption: Rest their chin on your shoulder
scenes.narration_line: Rest their chin on your shoulder, supporting head and shoulders.
scenes.evidence: With your baby's chin resting on your shoulder
safety_points: Support the head and shoulder area with one hand.

scenes.caption: Gently rub or pat their back
scenes.narration_line: Gently rub or pat your baby's back.
scenes.evidence: gently rub and pat your baby's back
safety_points: A couple of minutes should be enough.
